race.comment: In a race where the form lacks depth FLYING BRANT (1) looks well-placed to score. Best figure this prep came three back when he led but ran out of condition and finished fourth over 1556m at Morphettville Parks. Subsequent runs over 1800m have been fair. Group 3 placegetter last prep who is very fit and should have a bit on this field. BAYOU MUSIC (3) ran on stoutly to finish second two back over 1400m at Murray Bridge then disappointed over this trip at Morphettville last time. Blinkers back on and will find this easier so it will be no surprise if he improves sharply. WIND RUSH (6) has been safely held in three runs this prep but will appreciate the step up to a mile now. SKYTALKER (2) is up sharply in trip but should have more to offer at the fourth run of the campaign. BOOLCUNDA DAWN (7) ran a better race last start and is not out of contention.
